about: The session API's reads: every query under these prefixes that svc-agents' door serves (src/door/calls.rs), each with one input its schema accepts. A key lacking agents:read is refused on each (J-agents-12 #1 tries every one, from this list). tests/session_reads.rs holds it to the door, so a new read fails on the pull request that adds it until it is listed here with an input (#8495). An input string <sessionId>, <runId>, <requestId> or <sessionB> stands for that id of the person's own session A, its first run, the request that started it, or session B; an entry with no input is called with none.

run.trace.why: One run's trace, by its session and the request that started it (J-agents-13).

run.background.get.why: A background run is read by its own id; the scope is checked before any run is looked up.

log.export.why: The whole log's export, a page at a time; refused before any page or audit row is written.

webhook.list.why: The run webhooks the person's code registered (J-agents-12 #5).
